meta.title: Android Networking, Web Stack, IPC Beyond Binder & Communication Systems
meta.subtitle: Beginner → Expert Masterclass Roadmap
meta.completionMessage: Congratulations! You have completed the masterclass roadmap for Android Networking, Web Stack, IPC Beyond Binder, and Communication Systems—covering everything from Netd and ConnectivityService to OkHttp internals, Chromium WebViews, BLE/NFC/USB hardware protocols, and network traffic reverse engineering!

stages.title: Stage 33 — Reverse Engineering Network Traffic
stages.subtitle: Static/Dynamic Analysis Checklist for Network Inspection

details.title: Network Reverse Engineering Checklist
items: Identifying HTTP client engines (OkHttp, Retrofit, Cronet, Ktor) in DEX bytecode
Extracting hardcoded API Base URLs and endpoint paths
Identifying WebSocket endpoints and frame handlers
Locating gRPC client stubs and `.proto` schema structures
Identifying binary serialization models (Protobuf, FlatBuffers, CBOR)
Auditing Certificate Pinning logic (OkHttp `CertificatePinner`, TrustKit, Native)
Locating custom TrustManagers and SSLBypasses in decompiled code
Tracing OAuth / OIDC authentication token request flows
Auditing WebView JavaScript bridges (`addJavascriptInterface`) and URL hooks
Locating BLE scanning, GATT characteristics, and service UUIDs
Inspecting NFC NDEF record handlers and HCE APDU command processing
Auditing USB Bulk Transfer endpoints and vendor commands
Identifying VPN TUN interface configuration and packet interception rules
Tracing FCM push notification token registration and data message payloads

details.title: Call Chain Tracing Pipeline
items: UI View → ViewModel / Repository → Retrofit API Interface → OkHttp Client → Interceptor Chain → SSLSocket / Conscrypt → Netd / Linux Kernel Socket
